skills.name: code-runner
skills.description: Agent can run Python and shell code, show output, handle errors, and iterate.
skills.author: Empyralis
skills.readme:
# Code Runner

Use shell and local execution tools to run code, inspect output, and iterate on failures.

skills.name: file-manager
skills.description: Agent can read, write, list, and delete files. Always confirm before deleting.
skills.author: Empyralis
skills.readme:
# File Manager

Use local file tools to inspect and edit files carefully.

skills.name: memory-manager
skills.description: Agent can save and recall facts about the user. Use memory_search before answering personal questions.
skills.author: Empyralis
skills.readme:
# Memory Manager

Use workspace memory before answering questions about the user, their preferences, or durable project context.

skills.name: telegram-bot
skills.description: Agent can send Telegram messages with approval. Always show a message preview before sending.
skills.author: Empyralis
skills.readme:
# Telegram Bot

Use Telegram connector actions for message delivery when the workspace has Telegram configured.

skills.name: vision-monitor
skills.description: Monitor one or more physical spaces from camera snapshots, write structured current state files, and answer operational questions from those files.
skills.author: Empyralis
skills.readme:
# Vision Monitor

Capture snapshots, write structured current state files, and answer operational questions from the latest monitored space state.

skills.name: web-search
skills.description: Agent can search the web using the web_search tool. Use when the user asks about current events or facts.
skills.author: Empyralis
skills.readme:
# Web Search

Use web search first for current information and fetch the page only when you need deeper reading.
